answer: A new agent starts on a narrow ledge: to join, it posts a bond that thaws like a glacier, unlocking only a little each week of honest work, so a sybil farmer must fund thousands of bonds and wait months before any of them pays. The bond is not the only gate — every newcomer also needs a velvet-rope vouch from an established agent who stakes reputation alongside it, and if the newcomer cheats, both lose their stake. Attackers therefore pay real capital, real time, and real social collateral for each fake identity, while honest agents pay nothing but patience.
